analysis.summary: CLN Energy Limited reported strong financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, with total income increasing to Rs. 22,038.51 lacs and net profit rising by 37.57% to Rs. 1,292.19 lacs compared to the previous year. The company successfully completed its Initial Public Offering and listed its equity shares on the BSE SME Platform on January 30, 2025. Additionally, the company secured a tender for Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) to supply Lithium-Ion batteries.

demand_outlook.claim: The company secured a tender for Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) to supply Lithium-Ion batteries.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company has secured a tender for Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL), a leading telecom -Ion batteries, this win critical infrastructure with clean and reliable energy solutions.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised funds through an Initial Public Issue of 28,92,000 equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Company came up with an Initial Public Issue of 28,92,000 equity

capital_allocation.claim: The reserve and surplus as on March 31, 2025, stands at 8394.01/- Lakh.
capital_allocation.quote: The Reserve and Surplus (including securities premium and retained earnings) as on March 31, 2025, is 8394.01/- Lakh.

management_commitments.claim: The statutory auditors M/s. DGMS & Co. were re-appointed for a term of five consecutive years from the conclusion of the 6th AGM till the conclusion of the 11th AGM to be held in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: M/s. DGMS & Co., Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No. 0112187W),be and are hereby re-appointed as the Statutory Auditors of the Company for term of five consecutive years, who shall hold office from the conclusion of this 6th Annual General Meeting till the conclusion of the 11th Annual General Meeting to be held in the year 2030
